Custom Natural Shades Fort Wayne Indiana

Woven shades bring natural texture to the room, with liner options for added privacy. Compare natural shade materials, weave density, and liners in the light of your Fort Wayne home.

Options & materialsFitting & installationCareQuestions

Look at the weave in daylight and after dark

Natural shades use woven materials such as bamboo, grasses, and other fibers. Variation in color and texture is part of their appearance. A weave that looks opaque in a sample can behave differently at a bright window, so we discuss privacy and lining as well as the finish.

Material and weave

Compare tight and open weaves, the scale of the fibers, and the color variation. The sample represents a natural material rather than a perfectly uniform printed surface. Ask what variation to expect across several shades in the same room.

Privacy and room-darkening liners

An unlined weave may let people see through it, particularly when the room is lit after dark. A liner changes the coverage and can alter the shade’s appearance. Confirm which liner options are compatible with the selected weave.

Fold, edge, and valance details

Look at how the shade folds when raised and how the top and edges are finished. These details matter when the treatment stands alone or sits behind drapery. We check the available finishing options for your chosen material.

Measured and installed for you

Natural shades installation in Fort Wayne

We measure the window and the depth available for the folded shade. On nearby windows, we discuss mounting height and how the natural variation will look across the room. Consider handles, trim, and space above the opening before settling on an inside or outside mount.

Before you choose

Moisture can damage natural fibers. Tell us about humidity or splashes near the window so we can help you choose a suitable material. If you want a more uniform surface or simpler light filtering, compare roller or Roman shades alongside the woven samples.

From samples to installation

David brings samples to your home and measures the opening. Once you have chosen the material and controls, we confirm the quote and expected timing. We return to install the treatment, check its operation, and show you how to use it.

Compare all shades

Caring for your natural shades

Handle the weave gently and follow its care instructions. Avoid soaking the fibers or scrubbing with household cleaners. Tell us about pets, frequent handling, or a kitchen location so we can discuss maintenance before you order.

Questions about natural shades

Talk through your windows, the room, and the options before ordering.

Call David at (260) 222-6467
Do natural shades provide privacy?

That depends on the weave, liner, and lighting. People may be able to see through an unlined shade after dark. We can show you lining options for more privacy.

Will every shade look exactly the same?

Natural materials can vary in color and texture. Discuss the acceptable variation before ordering several shades, particularly on adjacent windows.

Can I choose cordless or motorized natural shades?

Ask about the controls available for the selected weave, lining, and dimensions. The combined weight and construction affect which systems can be used.
